# Resolución paso a paso

## 📌 Expresión original
$$((127 \times 53) - (89 \times 47)) \div 13$$

---

## Paso 1: Calcular 127 × 53

Multiplico 127 por 53:

| 127 × 50 | 127 × 3 | **Total** |
|----------|---------|-----------|
| 6,350    | 381     | **6,731** |

$$127 \times 53 = 6{,}731$$

---

## Paso 2: Calcular 89 × 47

Multiplico 89 por 47:

| 89 × 40 | 89 × 7 | **Total** |
|---------|--------|-----------|
| 3,560   | 623    | **4,183** |

$$89 \times 47 = 4{,}183$$

---

## Paso 3: Restar los resultados

$$6{,}731 - 4{,}183 = 2{,}548$$

---

## Paso 4: Dividir entre 13

$$2{,}548 \div 13 = 196$$

Verificación: $196 \times 13 = 2{,}548$ ✓

---

## ✅ Resultado final

$$\boxed{196}$$
